name: Product Roadmap Infographics
tagline: Roadmap-first infographic deck with gray road paths, dashed lane markings, milestone pins, swimlanes, and release planning layouts.

palette.description: White background, black type, gray road forms, pale shadows, blue milestone pins, purple and orange planning accents.

typography.style: Condensed black roadmap headings with compact planning labels.

best_for: Product strategy, roadmap reviews, quarterly planning, launch sequencing, migration plans, and dependency discussions.
avoid_for: Text-heavy reports, emotional brand stories, or presentations without timeline or planning structure.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Product Roadmap Infographics
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: gray road paths, dashed lane marks, blue and purple pins, and roadmap infographic modules. No source assets are embedded.
